headline: OpenAI's new math results draw praise and concern
summary: OpenAI released another large batch of mathematical results, with one outlet citing 722 manuscripts covering 372 result families, mostly produced from a single prompt to one AI agent. Mathematicians and outlets report concern that OpenAI isn't doing enough due diligence and that the results don't yet meet the field's standards.
